q8_justification: Trisolaris operates under a princeps who controls military and science budgets, unilaterally decides on Project Sophon, and orders executions. Single authoritarian authority.
q9_justification: Project Sophon is weapons development: transforming protons into superintelligent computers to infiltrate and sabotage Earth's scientific infrastructure. The chapter details the engineering of this strategic weapon.
q10_justification: All space activity serves the military objective of conquering Earth: building the orbital particle accelerator, creating sophons, and deploying them as strategic weapons.
q11_justification: The sophons operate as abstract, networked intelligence infiltrating physical space at the subatomic level. They multitask across accelerators like networked agents, analogous to cyberspace warfare.
q12_justification: Protons unfolded into lower dimensions: a 1D string thousands of light-hours long, 2D membranes wrapping around a planet, 3D geometric solids with intelligence. Physics is fundamentally unlike Earth experience.
